title: Source attribution and bounded-subset transformation
modification: Only indexed GED records are copied to small gzip subset shards. All retained original provider attributes are unchanged. This is a transformed distribution, not the full source partitions; original partition and per-row hashes remain available.

datasets.title: UCDP GED · selected Middle East history
datasets.publisher: Uppsala Conflict Data Program, Uppsala University
attribution: UCDP GED Global version 26.1, Uppsala University.
Davies, Pettersson and Öberg (2026), Organized violence 1989–2025, and violent political protests. https://doi.org/10.1093/jopres/xjag046
Sundberg and Melander (2013), Introducing the UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset. Journal of Peace Research 50(4), 523–532.

Modified distribution: selected countries and provider years, whole-record scope filtering, normalized index fields and deterministic sharding. Original retained field values are unchanged. No provider endorsement is implied.
limitations: Historical coded observations, 2000–2025; not a current operational feed.
A selected-country subset, not complete violence, news or policy coverage.
Provider country labels and coordinates are retained; lookup codes do not assert political boundaries or legal status.
The provider Israel category contains location records in Gaza and the West Bank; no separate country series is invented.
A coordinate can represent an administrative area, broad feature, country or estimated sea/air location; inspect where_prec.
Date windows and date_prec are preserved; midnight strings in the raw source are not precise event timestamps.
Low, best and high are provider estimates, not confidence intervals. Aggregate reporting can yield nonordered estimates; values are not repaired.
Clear is the provider coding status, not a human review or a guarantee of truth.
Source references are bibliographic metadata. Original news articles and private evidence are not bundled.
Some whole records are omitted by publication scope; absence is not evidence of no violence.

datasets.title: World Development Indicators · selected Middle East economies
datasets.publisher: World Bank and the original providers named in indicator metadata
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0; World Bank dataset terms also apply
datasets.attribution: The World Bank: World Development Indicators: original data providers named in each indicator’s metadata. Retrieved 2026-11-05.
limitations: Annual economy-level context; not local conditions or conflict-event evidence.
Nulls and unreturned periods are separate coverage gaps, never zero, interpolation or carried-forward values.
Values can be model estimates. Blank provider status is unknown; explicitly flagged forecasts and unrecognized flags are withheld.
Each series has its own units, denominator, coverage and source methodology; no regional totals or causal links are computed.
Same country/year alignment with conflict events is descriptive and does not identify a causal relationship.

annual_example.qualification: An annual provider population estimate. Display unit comes from series metadata; raw unit is retained separately. No physical sensor or exact measurement day is asserted.

application_rights: Workbench application rights remain reserved; source-data licences do not grant an application licence.
